items.title: Glenn Zottola interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 7, 2020
items.q: I don’t know him at all, I don’t even know his music. I know who he is.

ctx.x: He said those guys back then, that was their spirit.
I’m shocked that he would — I don’t know him at all, I don’t even know his music. I know who he is. I’m shocked he said this, and I admire him for saying that.
